# Loading Libraries and Data
```{r message=FALSE}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
```

```{r}
# Load the SKCM data
load("SKCM.rda")
```


# Exploring the Batch Variables
```{r message=FALSE}
# Extract batch information from TCGA barcodes
ids <- as.character(colData(query2)$barcode)
batch <- sapply(strsplit(ids, "-"), function(x) { 
  if (length(x) >= 6) 
    return(x[6]) 
  else 
    return(NA)
})
batch_id <- as.factor(batch)

# Check batch distribution
batch_counts <- table(batch_id, useNA = "ifany")
print(batch_counts)

# Create a dataframe with batch information
batch_info <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(query2),
  batch_id = batch_id,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Extract essential clinical information
clinical <- colData(query2) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, gender, vital_status, days_to_death, 
               ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis)

# Create proper survival object
clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = days_to_death / 365,
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age_years = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  )

# Join clinical data with batch information
clinical_with_batch <- clinical %>%
  mutate(batch_id = batch_id)

# Add survival groups for visualization
surv_tertiles <- quantile(clinical$survival_time, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
clinical_with_batch$survival_group <- cut(clinical$survival_time, 
                            breaks = surv_tertiles, 
                            include.lowest = TRUE, 
                            labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))
```


# Expression Data Pre-Processing
```{r}
# Get FPKM-UQ expression data
fpkm <- assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand")

# Log2 transform expression data
log_expr <- log2(fpkm + 1)

# Check basic statistics
summary(log_expr[1:5, 1:5])

# Filter low-expressed genes
gene_means <- rowMeans(log_expr)
expressed_genes <- which(gene_means > 1)  # Keep genes with average log2(FPKM+1) > 1
log_expr_filtered <- log_expr[expressed_genes, ]
cat("Original number of genes:", nrow(log_expr), "\n")
cat("Number of expressed genes kept:", nrow(log_expr_filtered), "\n")
```


# Examining Data Distribution Before Batch Correction

## Overall Distribution by Batch
```{r}
# Create a data frame for plotting
expr_melt <- melt(log_expr_filtered[1:1000, ], varnames = c("gene", "sample"), value.name = "expression")
expr_melt$batch_id <- batch_info$batch_id[match(expr_melt$sample, batch_info$sample)]

# Plot distribution by batch
p1 <- ggplot(expr_melt, aes(x = expression, color = batch_id)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Gene Expression Distribution by Batch (Before Correction)",
       x = "log2(FPKM + 1)", y = "Density", color = "Batch ID")
print(p1)

# Boxplot of expression values by batch
p2 <- ggplot(expr_melt, aes(x = batch_id, y = expression, fill = batch_id)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Expression Values by Batch (Before Correction)",
       x = "Batch ID", y = "log2(FPKM + 1)", fill = "Batch ID")
print(p2)
```

## PCA Analysis Before Batch Correction
```{r}
# Select top variable genes for PCA
gene_vars <- apply(log_expr_filtered, 1, var)
top_var_genes <- order(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:2000]
expr_top_var <- log_expr_filtered[top_var_genes, ]

# Perform PCA on top variable genes
pca_result <- prcomp(t(expr_top_var), scale = TRUE)
pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:5])

# Add batch and survival information
pca_data$batch_id <- batch_id
pca_data$survival_group <- clinical_with_batch$survival_group

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained <- (pca_result$sdev^2) / sum(pca_result$sdev^2) * 100

# PCA plot by batch
p3 <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = batch_id)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA of Gene Expression by Batch (Before Correction)",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
       color = "Batch ID")
print(p3)

# PCA plot by survival group
p4 <- ggplot(na.omit(pca_data), aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = survival_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "PCA of Gene Expression by Survival Group (Before Correction)",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
       color = "Survival Group")
print(p4)
```

# Batch Correction using limma's removeBatchEffect
```{r}
complete_samples <- !is.na(batch_id) & !is.na(clinical_with_batch$survival_group) & !is.na(clinical_with_batch$gender)

# Filter relevant data toinclude complete cases
log_expr_filtered_clean <- log_expr_filtered[, complete_samples]
batch_id_clean <- batch_id[complete_samples]
clinical_clean <- clinical_with_batch[complete_samples, ]

# design matrix based on the cleaned data
model_df <- data.frame(
  survival_group = clinical_clean$survival_group,
  gender = clinical_clean$gender
)

# model matrix with right dimensions
design <- model.matrix(~0 + survival_group + gender, data = model_df)
colnames(design) <- c("Low", "Medium", "High", "gender")

# dimensions before applying removeBatchEffect
cat("Expression data dimensions:", dim(log_expr_filtered_clean), "\n")
cat("Batch ID length:", length(batch_id_clean), "\n")
cat("Design matrix dimensions:", dim(design), "\n")

# removeBatchEffect with the properly aligned data
combat_expr <- removeBatchEffect(log_expr_filtered_clean, 
                               batch = batch_id_clean,
                               design = design)
```

# Statistical Assessment of Batch Effect Removal
```{r}
calc_batch_effect <- function(expr_data, batch) {
  p_values <- numeric(nrow(expr_data))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(expr_data)) {
    # ANOVA
    fit <- aov(expr_data[i,] ~ as.factor(batch))
    p_values[i] <- summary(fit)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
  }
  
  # Adjust for multiple testing
  p_adj <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BH")
  
  # Count significant genes
  sig_genes <- sum(p_adj < 0.05)
  
  return(list(
    sig_genes = sig_genes,
    prop_sig_genes = sig_genes / length(p_values),
    p_values = p_values,
    p_adj = p_adj
  ))
}

# Subset data
set.seed(123)
gene_subset <- sample(1:nrow(log_expr_filtered), 1000)

# Calculate batch effect before correction
batch_effect_before <- calc_batch_effect(log_expr_filtered[gene_subset,], batch_id)

# Calculate batch effect after correction  
batch_effect_after <- calc_batch_effect(combat_expr[gene_subset,], batch_id_clean)

# Display results
cat("Before batch correction:\n")
cat("  Number of genes significantly affected by batch:", batch_effect_before$sig_genes, "\n")
cat("  Proportion of genes affected:", round(batch_effect_before$prop_sig_genes * 100, 2), "%\n\n")

cat("After batch correction:\n")
cat("  Number of genes significantly affected by batch:", batch_effect_after$sig_genes, "\n")
cat("  Proportion of genes affected:", round(batch_effect_after$prop_sig_genes * 100, 2), "%\n")

# Compare p-value distributions
p_val_df <- data.frame(
  p_value = c(batch_effect_before$p_values, batch_effect_after$p_values),
  Correction = rep(c("Before", "After"), each = length(gene_subset))
)

p17 <- ggplot(p_val_df, aes(x = p_value, fill = Correction)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, position = "identity", bins = 30) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Batch Effect p-values Before and After Correction",
       x = "p-value", y = "Count")
print(p17)
```


# Heatmap Visualization
```{r}
# Select top 50 variable genes for visualization
top_50_var <- order(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:50]

# Create heatmap
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Batch = batch_id,
  Survival = clinical_with_batch$survival_group,
  Gender = clinical_with_batch$gender
)
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(log_expr_filtered)

# Color palettes
ann_colors <- list(
  Batch = viridis::viridis(length(unique(batch_id))),
  Survival = c("Low" = "#e31a1c", "Medium" = "#ffbf00", "High" = "#1f78b4"),
  Gender = c(female = "#ff7f0e", male = "#1f77b4")
)
names(ann_colors$Batch) <- levels(as.factor(batch_id))

# Heatmap before batch correction
pheatmap(log_expr_filtered[top_50_var, ], 
         scale = "row", 
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         show_rownames = FALSE, 
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         main = "Expression Heatmap Before Batch Correction",
         clustering_method = "ward.D2")

# Heatmap after batch correction
pheatmap(combat_expr[top_50_var, ], 
         scale = "row", 
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         show_rownames = FALSE, 
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         main = "Expression Heatmap After Batch Correction",
         clustering_method = "ward.D2")
```




# Effects on Biological Signal
```{r}
# Get top survival-associated genes 
survival_assoc <- function(expr_data, survival_group) {
  p_values <- numeric(nrow(expr_data))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(expr_data)) {
    # Skip genes with missing values
    if (any(is.na(expr_data[i,]))) {
      p_values[i] <- NA
      next
    }
    
    # Perform ANOVA for survival groups
    fit <- aov(expr_data[i,] ~ survival_group)
    p_values[i] <- tryCatch({
      summary(fit)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
    }, error = function(e) {
      NA
    })
  }
  
  return(p_values)
}

complete_samples <- !is.na(batch_id) & !is.na(clinical_with_batch$survival_group) & !is.na(clinical_with_batch$gender)
clinical_clean <- clinical_with_batch[complete_samples, ]

# complete_cases based on the filtered clinical data
complete_cases_clean <- complete.cases(clinical_clean$survival_group)
surv_group_clean <- clinical_clean$survival_group[complete_cases_clean]

# Calculate survival association before correction
surv_pvals_before <- survival_assoc(log_expr_filtered[gene_subset, complete_samples][, complete_cases_clean], surv_group_clean)

# Calculate survival association after correction
surv_pvals_after <- survival_assoc(combat_expr[gene_subset, complete_cases_clean], surv_group_clean)

# Compare results
surv_df <- data.frame(
  gene = 1:length(gene_subset),
  p_before = surv_pvals_before,
  p_after = surv_pvals_after
)

# Count significant genes before and after
sig_before <- sum(p.adjust(surv_pvals_before, method = "BH") < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)
sig_after <- sum(p.adjust(surv_pvals_after, method = "BH") < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Genes significantly associated with survival (FDR < 0.1):\n")
cat("  Before batch correction:", sig_before, "\n")
cat("  After batch correction:", sig_after, "\n")

# Plot correlation between p-values
p18 <- ggplot(na.omit(surv_df), aes(x = -log10(p_before), y = -log10(p_after))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Survival Association p-values: Before vs After Batch Correction",
       x = "-log10(p-value) Before Correction", 
       y = "-log10(p-value) After Correction")
print(p18)
```

```{r}
batch_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Genes Significantly Affected by Batch",
    "% Genes Affected by Batch",
    "Genes Associated with Survival (FDR < 0.1)"
  ),
  Before_Correction = c(
    batch_effect_before$sig_genes,
    round(batch_effect_before$prop_sig_genes * 100, 2),
    sig_before
  ),
  After_Correction = c(
    batch_effect_after$sig_genes,
    round(batch_effect_after$prop_sig_genes * 100, 2),
    sig_after

print(batch_summary, row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE)
```
